03-1.title: Token
03-1.tldr: The smallest sub-word unit of text a model processes.
points: A sub-word piece, not a word.

03-2.title: Embedding
03-2.tldr: A numeric vector representing the meaning of text, used for similarity search.

03-3.title: Context window
03-3.tldr: The maximum amount of text a model can process in a single request.

03-4.title: Temperature
03-4.tldr: Controls sampling randomness; lower values produce more deterministic output.

03-5.title: Top-p (nucleus sampling)
03-5.tldr: Limits token selection to the smallest set whose cumulative probability exceeds p.

03-6.title: RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
03-6.tldr: Giving a model external data by retrieving relevant passages and putting them in the prompt before generation.

03-7.title: Chunking
03-7.tldr: Splitting documents into smaller pieces before embedding so retrieval returns relevant sections.

03-8.title: Vector database
03-8.tldr: A database built for similarity search over embeddings rather than exact-match queries.

03-9.title: Reranking
03-9.tldr: Reordering retrieved documents by actual relevance (often a cross-encoder) after a broad initial retrieval.

03-10.title: Hallucination
03-10.tldr: Confident but factually incorrect or unsupported output.

03-11.title: Fine-tuning
03-11.tldr: Further training a model on a specific dataset to adjust its behavior or style.

03-12.title: Prompt engineering
03-12.tldr: Structuring input to get a reliable, specific output without changing the model.

03-13.title: Few-shot prompting
03-13.tldr: Providing a small number of examples in the prompt to guide output format or behavior.
points: A few examples in the prompt.

03-14.title: Chain-of-thought prompting
03-14.tldr: Asking the model to reason step by step before giving a final answer.
points: Can be implicit in reasoning models.

03-15.title: Function calling
03-15.tldr: A model's ability to emit a structured request to invoke an external tool or API.

03-16.title: Agent
03-16.tldr: A system where the model plans, calls tools, and decides its own next step in a loop.

03-17.title: Memory
03-17.tldr: Context an agent retains across turns (short-term) or sessions (long-term).
points: Retrieval chooses what to bring back.

03-18.title: Latency
03-18.tldr: The time between sending a request and receiving a complete response.

03-19.title: Quantization
03-19.tldr: Reducing a model's numerical precision to shrink size and speed up inference.

03-20.title: Prompt injection
03-20.tldr: Malicious or unintended instructions embedded in input or retrieved content that hijack the model.
